rule_outs: Dwelling 4 m from the best section
summary: Steep, narrow street lined with homes 4-19 m from the kerb.
reasons: Narrow lane, few cars park here

drivers.seclusion: Houses and pools on both sides; every stretch has a dwelling within 4-19 m of the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with a few resident cars parked; kerb meets fences and trees with little room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped; only a few residents' cars park along it.

flags: Steep: 7.8% mean, up to 14% in places
Dwellings within 10 m at several points (4-9 m)
Heavy tree canopy along the middle stretch
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the middle and downhill sections; open near the start.
